title: Owned native audio continuous reliable signaling
scope: Isolated local macOS arm64: complete SDK61 plus54 distinct actual native runtime cases. Runtime includes42 affected cases,10 capability cases, new owned220-burst and blocked-cleanup case. Both signature algorithms exercised by named cases; no Linux/remote/browser/external-provider qualification.
implementation: A single task owns the exact original reliable reader after actual signed audio preparation; verifier context and replay cache remain shared with the original peer.
Foreground audio/event waits do not cancel actual partial signaling IO. Selector command cancellation retains a separate uncertainty guard and retires its original physical peer.
Only five passive native fact kinds coalesce by exact resource; other replies/signals, including DTMF, retain order.128 frames/2MiB bound the inbox; explicit failure retires the peer.

Idle signaling does not inherit an RPC timeout. First frame byte starts the frame deadline; original credential and server-key expiry bound the entire task. Invalid/partial framing, signatures and terminal auth facts stop the original peer.
Public/private/handoff audio wrappers expose receive_signaling. Task ownership ends on peer destruction.

Terminal signed auth observations already received by the owned task remain readable from its bounded inbox after retirement. Ended inbox reads refuse immediately rather than waiting again. Cached facts cannot restart current transport IO.

Explicit Utc checks bound continuously-ready frames at credential/key expiry. Owned selector deadline is clipped to the original credential/key expiry and rechecks current state before applying an ACK.
